summary: Expose Node-specific CLI options separately from script/user arguments.

semantics.contents: Node-specific command-line options used to launch the process
semantics.excludes: executable, script path, and user arguments after the script

caveats: A generic host command-line parser cannot infer Node option partitioning after compilation unless the launcher preserves it.
